mapper.select: SELECT id, name, content_type, display_order, is_visible FROM info_categories ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, content_type, display_order, is_visible FROM info_categories WHERE is_visible = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, content_type, display_order, is_visible FROM info_categories WHERE is_visible = 1 AND content_type = #{contentType} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO info_categories (name, content_type, display_order, is_visible) VALUES (#{name}, #{contentType}, #{displayOrder}, #{isVisible})
